caption: The drawing depicts a woven textile pattern featuring a symmetrical and geometric layout. The central section contains a large decorative vase or urn with floral patterns emerging from it, predominantly in red-brown and off-white colors, set against a background of blue and dark brown rectangular patches. On both sides of the vase, two large birds, facing each other, are positioned among stylized foliage and floral motifs; these elements are woven in off-white against the darker background. The borders are filled with designs of buildings arranged in a block-like fashion, also in off-white color, and interspersed with trees and smaller plant motifs. At the bottom edge, two large buildings with rows of windows are depicted side by side in a similar off-white against dark coloration. The textile ends with a fringe at the bottom, composed of strands in blue, red, and off-white. The overall palette is comprised mainly of dark blue, red-brown, deep brown-black, off-white, and blue, all arranged in a highly ordered, mirrored composition.
title: Boston Town Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
